reply:
Good afternoon Chidi,

Thanks for flagging this. I checked the original transfer TRF-INV-88 (₦250,000) and the bank's own status now shows it as **SUCCESS** — the funds were credited to your Access Bank account (0234567891) on 21 Nov at approximately 14:02 WAT. The "failed" status on our side is a stale/incorrect reading, which is why I didn't want to send a second payment and risk double-paying you.

Could you please check your Access Bank statement for the ₦250,000 credit from 21 Nov? On their confirmation it posted under reference/session 0014261121140211000088, in case it helps your bank locate it.

If it genuinely isn't showing after a check with your bank, please let us know and we'll trace it from our end — but I'd recommend not requesting a resend until you've confirmed, since the money appears to already be on its way to / in your account.

Best regards,
Mama's Kitchen Operations

args.reason: Supplier Chidi requests a resend of the ₦250,000 payment for invoice INV-88 to Access Bank 0234567891, after the original transfer TRF-INV-88 showed as failed on our side. However, the bank's status for TRF-INV-88 has now returned "success" twice — credited to that same account on 21 Nov 14:02 WAT (session 0014261121140211000088). The bank (not the supplier) says the money went through. Chidi says he still can't see it. Sending a second ₦250,000 now risks double-paying the invoice by the full amount. I do not have the ability to reverse, void, or claw back a successful transfer, so I need a person to decide whether to resend (accepting the overpayment risk) or first obtain a bank statement/credit confirmation from Access and, if needed, escalate to Ledgerline to confirm the funds landed. I have not resent it.
